location.description: Premium estate neighbourhood in south Mississauga between Port Credit and Clarkson, bounded by QEW to the north and Lake Ontario to the south. Sub-communities: Whiteoaks of Jalna (100ft+ lots, most prestigious), Watercolours (2000s-era construction), Lorne Park Estates (lakefront, private roads).

demographics.demographics_note: Primarily European/British-heritage community. 40% earn $200K+ annually — among highest income concentration in Mississauga.

market_data.market_condition: Active — 95% sell-to-list ratio. 14.7% YoY price increase. Upper end buyer's market with meaningful inventory.
market_data.note: School boundary (LPSS catchment) is primary price driver per third-party sources

history.founding_note: Named after the Marquess of Lorne — John Douglas Sutherland Campbell, Governor General of Canada 1878–1883, married Princess Louise (4th daughter of Queen Victoria).
history.development: Developed as planned estate community early-to-mid 20th century. Post-WWII acceleration brought executive class from Toronto seeking large-lot estates with Lake Ontario proximity.
